title: Unable to update gr.Examples getting AttributeError: 'Examples' object has no attribute '_id'
body:
### Describe the bug

while looking deeply for the answers myself I am frustrated and could not find the solution

so Below is some code 
```python

# Gradio Interface
```

comments.body: @participant1 seems like there are a few issues here, most importantly that gr.Examples itself is not a Component, but a gr.Dataset wrapper - if a user wanted to update it, they would have to target the .dataset property of gr.Examples, which is not documented.

comments.body: That's true we should document this, or maybe give `gr.Examples()` an `.update()` method which updates the underlying `dataset`

comments.author: participant6
comments.body:
I figured it out!
First: 
```python
user_chat_bot_suggest = gr.Example(...)

def fn(...):
    return gr.Dataset.update(samples=suggests).  # suggests: List[List[str]]
```
then:
```python
gr.SOMETHING.change().then(fn,
    inputs=[...],
    outputs=[user_chat_bot_suggest.dataset])
```
It works for me!

comments.body:
Apologies for the long resolution on this. I am [working on a PR](https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/pull/8745) that will allow this to happen. You can test it by doing:

```
pip install https://gradio-builds.s3.amazonaws.com/c2dc8a1bd9585c3170a116d12a465be9223f1310/gradio-4.37.2-py3-none-any.whl
```

The syntax you'll need to use is to pass in the `example.dataset` as the output component. There's an example in the PR if you'd like to take a look!
